in_hebrew.name: פיפינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Fifine means 'daughter of wisdom'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'pina' (wisdom) and 'yonah' (daughter).

in_greek.name: Φιφίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Fifine means 'wisdom'. It is derived from the Greek word 'phronesis' (wisdom).

in_latin.name: Philina
